caption: The drawing features a single sculptural fragment depicting the head of a lion. The lion's head is rendered in shades of gray, with the texture and shading giving the appearance of a stone or carved surface. The facial features of the lion, including its nose, mouth, and prominent eyes, are clearly outlined, with the eyes appearing hollow or recessed. The lion's mane is indicated by wavy carved lines around the top and sides of the head. The lower portion of the head is broken, exposing a rough, jagged edge. The background is an even, off-white or light beige color, free from any additional objects or patterns, providing contrast and focus on the lion head fragment centered in the composition.
title: Lion's Head (one of pair)
